app.name: LexiQode
explorer.noFolder: No folder is open. File ▸ Open Folder, or Ctrl+K Ctrl+O.
explorer.deleteDetail: The item can be restored from the recycle bin.
search.idle: Type to search. Results appear as they are found.
search.needsFolder: Search runs over the files of an open folder.
git.title: Source control
git.noRepo: This folder is not a git repository.
git.needsFolder: The repository is read from the open folder.
git.discardDetail: This cannot be undone: the file returns to its last committed state.
git.fetchHint: See what is new on the remote. Your files are not changed.
git.pullHint: Bring new commits from the remote into the current branch.
git.pushHint: Send your commits to the remote.
git.fetchFailed: the remote could not be checked
git.pullFailed: the changes could not be pulled
git.pushFailed: the changes could not be pushed
terminal.empty: No terminal is open. Press the + button.
terminal.intro: This panel runs commands in a piped shell: git, python, npm and builds work, full-screen programs do not.
chat.title: Assistant
chat.placeholder: Ask, plan, debug or hand over a task…
chat.stepOfHint: The step ceiling for one turn: {max}. A step is one request to the model plus the tool calls it asks for, so real work is almost always shorter than this number.
chat.stoppedNotice: Stopped by you: the agent ended the turn here. Send another message to carry on.
chat.stepLimit: The turn ran out of steps: its whole budget of {steps} is spent. That is a ceiling, not a failure - the next turn carries on.
chat.continueHint: Send a message asking the agent to carry on from where it stopped
chat.continueMessage: Carry on from where you stopped.
chat.empty: The conversation is empty. Write a task - the mode next to the field decides what the agent may do.
chat.needsFolder: Open a folder first: the assistant works inside it.
chat.reasoningOn: The model reasons before it answers — click to turn reasoning off (reasoning_effort: none)
chat.reasoningOff: Reasoning is off — click to turn it on
chat.compactedTimes: Context was compacted {times} time(s): {dropped} messages replaced
chat.droppedTimes: Context was reduced {times} time(s): {dropped} messages dropped
chat.compactedHistory: The context was compacted here: part of the conversation was replaced by a summary, which is what the agent remembers instead.
chat.deleteDetail: The conversation is removed from disk and cannot be restored.
chat.contextHint: the model's window; at {percent}% of it the oldest messages are replaced by a summary.
chat.contextEstimated: estimated by the core; the server reported none.
chat.modeAgentHint: Do the work: read, edit and run what the task needs.
chat.modeAskHint: Answer from what is already known. No edits, no commands.
chat.modePlanHint: Read and propose a plan. Nothing is changed.
chat.modeDebugHint: Find the cause, then fix it and prove the fix.
chat.modeReviewHint: Read the change and report problems. No edits.
settings.title: Agent settings
settings.contextWindowHint: How many tokens the model accepts in one request. The core uses it to decide when to compact the conversation.
settings.maxOutputHint: How many tokens one answer may occupy. That room is subtracted from the window before compaction.
settings.autoCompactHint: Share of the window after which the oldest messages are replaced by a summary. Lower compacts sooner.
settings.maxStepsHint: How many steps one turn may take. A step is one request to the model plus the tool calls it asks for, so real work is almost always longer than this number suggests.
settings.maxHistoryHint: A hard ceiling on the number of messages, whatever the window allows. A backstop for an endpoint whose tokens cost more than the four-characters-per-token estimate; a normal session never reaches it.
settings.scanning: Asking the endpoint for its models…
settings.scanHint: Fill in the endpoint and the key; the model list is fetched for you.
settings.scanFound: {count} models offered. Click one to use it:
welcome.title: No folder is open
welcome.hint: Open a folder to work in it, and so that the assistant can see your code.
welcome.keys: Ctrl+P to go to a file · Ctrl+Shift+P for commands · Ctrl+Shift+A for the assistant
cmd.runFile: Run the file in the shell
run.noFile: Open a file to run it
run.unsupported: {path}: no run command is known for this kind of file
run.hint: Runs the open file in the shell below: .js, .mjs and .cjs through node, .py through python, .ps1, .bat, .cmd and .sh through their own interpreter
toast.saveBeforeCloseDetail: Closing without saving discards the changes in this tab.
toast.outsideFolder: {path} is outside the open folder; open its folder first
toast.binary: {path} looks binary and is not opened as text
toast.tooLarge: {path} is larger than the view limit and was not opened
toast.noPython: no Python was found: the assistant will not be able to run
cmd.checkUpdates: Updates: check for a newer release
cmd.switchTheme: Appearance: dark, light or the system's
chat.modelHint: Choose a model in the agent settings; the list comes from the endpoint.
chat.modelFailed: Model: {model} - the endpoint could not be asked: {message}
chat.contextFull: at most {count} files can go with one message
settings.themeHint: Changed here, from the status bar or from the palette; all three write the same setting.
settings.languageHint: The window's own language. The system's by default.
settings.reopenLastFolder: reopen the last folder on start
settings.excludeHint: One pattern per line. Used by the file tree, the search and the folder watcher.
settings.terminalShellHint: Empty means this platform's own: powershell.exe on Windows.
settings.openWithFolder: open a shell when a folder is opened
settings.openWithFolderHint: The panel below then shows a shell already in the folder that was just opened.
settings.agentAutoStart: start the assistant with a folder
settings.includeSelection: send the selected text with a message
settings.checkOnStart: look for a new release on start
settings.updateRepoHint: Empty means this application's own repository. Owner/name.
update.title: An update is available
update.pageHint: The archive and its digest are on the release page: unpack it over the current folder while the application is closed.
update.noPage: there is no release page to open: no repository is configured
toast.contextRemoved: {path} stays out of the next message
